free_tier.stated: 'Mevcut VPS'yi en az 1 ay i in sipari edin veya uzat n' (order or extend an existing VPS for at least one month), then publish an honest review of THE.Hosting and follow its social accounts to receive 'ek 30, 14 veya 7 g n' (an extra 30, 14 or 7 days) depending on the plan tier. There is no free VPS: the free days are an extension of a paid order.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: None: it is a discount on a paid server, and a user is not buying one to unlock a rebate.

limits.value: The scheme is not a free tier at all: step one is to buy a month of VPS, so the 'free' days are a rebate worth at most one month and the first thing that fails is the requirement to pay before anything is granted.
